page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible at the left margin and between the lines; it is not transcribed. The running head contains a decorative Roman-numeral line that is only partly legible, so the words after "II." are marked illegible. The catchword "beri" completes the split word "adhi-beri" on the next page. Printed spelling is kept, including "R.potestas", "ciuiū", and the split "il lum", which is written as "illum". Long s is written as plain s, and the printed tildes are kept.
